setup: 16 independent synthetic 20-day seeds, rewards on, one reroll per instrument offer; both advisers play every action independently using the same unchanged game rules. Hidden future information is withheld.
after: Completed simulation leader; 2000 per ordinary action and 8000 per instrument/gift choice. Same rollout continuation policy.
limitations: Small paired experiment, not a guarantee of improved Rainbow or actual user profit; this compares our old/new assessment, not the closed Giboork implementation.
mcStreams: One native MC stream per adviser, matching controller/quota semantics; not identical browser worker stream seeds.
releaseDecision: Opt-in prerelease. No measured improvement on these 16 pairs; stable v1.1.1 is not replaced by automatic update.
